_what: A477 (2026-11-23). Known drift of each ledger from ops/RECORD_ANCHORS.json, keyed by the EXACT current head hash. RECORDED, NOT ACCEPTED: accepted is always false here, because accepting a drift is the operator re-anchoring (`python covenant_sentinels.py --anchor`), never an entry in this file. test_ra1_record_anchors.py fails on a drift this file does not name, on a head that moved again (new hash), on a row whose class no longer matches the measurement, on a row for a ledger that matches its anchor again (stale), and on any row with accepted not false.

docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md.reason: A dated note (A274, 2026-10-06, commit 12b4718) was inserted inside an early entry at line 192; it reached main's first-parent line in merge 46fbe4a on 2026-10-08. Every anchored line is still present, in order.

ops/DISTILL.md.reason: No committed version of this file ever hashed to its anchor: the 2026-09-09 anchor was taken from a working tree whose bytes were never committed (the file is rewritten by the running system).

ops/NIGHTLY.md.reason: No committed version of this file ever hashed to its anchor: the 2026-09-09 anchor was taken from a working tree whose bytes were never committed (the file is rewritten by the running system).

ops/SELF_EVAL.md.reason: The ledger puts new rounds at the top and drops old ones (first seen at merge 3724eb0, 2026-10-03): it is not append-only, so a head anchor cannot hold for it. On a node that runs self-evaluation the head changes every round, so RA1 does not compare it (see PREPENDING in test_ra1_record_anchors.py); a retention rule that fits this ledger is the operator's decision.

ops/verdicts.jsonl.reason: Old rows were re-serialized: the 2026-09-04 rows' judge field now names the teacher panel and carries a panel field. That version reached main in the A416 consolidation (bd7eacf, 2026-11-09). A101 (2026-09-12) says older single-teacher rows are kept as legacy; whether this rewrite was intended is UNDETERMINED.
